verdict.rationale: Zapier MCP explicitly lets users 'describe what you need in plain language' and the AI 'calls the right Zapier action and confirms what it did', enabling natural-language operation across 9,000+ apps via Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor with managed auth. This is well documented first-party but lacks independent hands-on corroboration of the NL experience itself. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports confirming natural-language command execution works reliably in practice.
